parsed.why: No criminalisation and police cooperate with the sole LGBTI group, but zero protections, no documented trans-specific acceptance, societal stigma, official insensitivity and undated assaults; thin data extrapolates below the acceptance tier.

Gender-identity hate-speech, hate-crime and anti-discrimination law actually operating; Pride shooter given maximum sentence; liberal society, no border or facility friction. Rising reports and falling clearance are offset by working rule of law.

Federal document/screening refusals plus facility bans in many states and documented custody harm give universal exposure; but no criminalisation of identity, many protective states, and the mean local regime is mixed.

Cross-dressing provision struck down 2022, yet official discrimination and strictly enforced morality laws persist (up to seven years), no recognition, protections or recourse; appearance-based detention recorded. High risk.

Identity law and courts that restored care and convicted a trans activist's killer count, but documented police mistreatment of visibly trans people, record hate crimes, refused aggravator and rollback decrees pull it down.
